title: Session
subtitle: 「時段／會議／預定活動／預約／課堂／會期」，究竟是哪一種 session？
description: 「時段／會議／預定活動／預約／課堂／會期」，究竟是哪一種 session？

words.note: 使用者提供。當 session 主要表示一段具有開始和結束時間的活動時段，而不強調會議形式或參與者互動時，period 很自然。它是最廣的時間性改寫之一。
words.example: The afternoon period lasted ninety minutes.

exercises.original: The training session lasted for two hours.
exercises.zh: 培訓時段持續了兩小時。
exercises.upgrade: period · 一段時間；時段；期間

options.explanation: lasted for two hours 重點是時長，而不是會議形式，因此 period 很自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: period 只強調一段時間；session 通常還暗示這段時間被用於某項特定活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The morning period lasted two hours. The training session included three exercises.

falseSynonyms.zh: meeting 需要多人聚集討論／決策；session 可以是課堂、治療、法院程序或單人活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The committee held a meeting. The therapy session lasted fifty minutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: appointment 強調預約；session 是實際活動時段本身，未必由 booking 產生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I booked an appointment with the therapist. The therapy session lasted an hour.

falseSynonyms.zh: class 是教學課堂；session 可以是會議、研討、治療、法庭等其他活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The class ended with a quiz. The committee session ended at noon.

falseSynonyms.zh: workshop 需要互動／實作特色；普通 lecture or meeting session 不一定是 workshop。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The workshop included hands-on practice. The morning session consisted of two lectures.

falseSynonyms.zh: sitting 是法院、議會或正式機構程序用語；一般培訓／輔導 session 不叫 sitting。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The court sitting was adjourned. The training session continued after lunch.

falseSynonyms.zh: consultation 需要專業建議／評估；一般會議或課堂 session 並不屬 consultation。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She booked a legal consultation. The class session begins at nine.

falseSynonyms.zh: term 是較長、制度化的學期／會期；單次 session 通常只是其中一個時段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The autumn term lasts twelve weeks. Each class session lasts ninety minutes.
